resolution: Player walked through every wall in both the live host and the compiled no-V8 game (but stairs/heightfields and dynamic barrels still collided). Root cause: collideSolidRects' slope_walkable side-push skip (framework/game/physics.zig) lacked the 'rect_height <= y + step_height' low-enough-to-step-onto guard that its sibling grace_walkable has. Walls carry a finite floor on purpose (so an upper-storey wall doesn't block lower floors), and finite_floor_band makes them eligible for the slope skip. Once the map ground became painted HEIGHTFIELD terrain, heightfieldSlopeGroundAt tripped everywhere, so every tall finite-floor wall (and solid prop) had its horizontal push skipped. Fix: add the same height guard to slope_walkable so tall walls are never slope-skipped while ramp-edge downhill-snap is preserved. One shared routine, so it fixes both builds. Verified by the user: walls block again.
